title: Sandbag Bear Hug Squat
description:
1. Select a manageable load, clear the area, and take a stable starting position for Sandbag Bear Hug Squat.
2. Hug the bag tightly to the torso, squat between the hips without rounding the back, then stand through the whole foot.
3. Return the load under control and repeat for the programmed repetitions.
